limits: No general kernel preemption, new driver/module parallelism or AP redistribution of existing BSP file workers. Volume metadata/backend fallback, one buffer-range lease and global reclaim entry retain serialization.

New pageable file buffer must fit one own fully committed VM range and available resident budget; controlled refusal otherwise. Paths/header outputs and raw/DMA APIs keep existing resident/pinned contracts.
